Here is what Coursera has actually been posting and launching lately, based on the signals I have collected.

## Recent TikTok Activity (Late July – Early August 2026)

Coursera’s TikTok strategy is heavy on **short, list-based "cheat sheet" content** aimed at tech career starters:

- **Aug 1** – "Python Projects you MUST build to look job-ready" (automation bot, web scraper, API app, ML mini-model, etc.) [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7669105389291572511|TikTok]]
- **Aug 1** – Engineering portfolio advice: showcase projects with real results and visuals [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7668864697554259214|TikTok]]
- **July 31** – AI + cybersecurity positioning: "AI is changing cybersecurity, but it's not replacing the people behind it," pushing Coursera Plus for cloud/AI/cyber skills [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7668483148245634318|TikTok]]
- **July 29** – Simplified AWS roadmap: "You don't need every AWS service. Just master the ones that actually run the cloud" (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudWatch, Route 53) [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7667750520546725150|TikTok]]
- **July 25** – "SQL in plain English" breakdown (SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY) [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7666332561743891725|TikTok]]
- **July 22** – AI explainer: "Ever wonder how AI actually 'thinks'?" framing understanding AI as the first step to using it smarter [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7665167177296727326|TikTok]]
- **July 15** – "5 Python libraries" for data science (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, Seaborn) [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7662615014687165726|TikTok]]
- **July 10** – **Learner Story Series** call for submissions: asking users to comment "story" to be featured [[cite:https://www.tiktok.com/@coursera/video/7660744824110271757|TikTok]]

[[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pQSOUpwffKA|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CxE7houWG68|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_zUJ1QOn58|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pbqn4qniiGA|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BBKJd7EoTko|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EQm96hGzP_w|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PLhbKrlif4I|YouTube]] [[cite:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=inx563S4D_g|YouTube]]

- **Coursera Coach** – An AI assistant embedded in the platform, powered by an OpenAI integration, providing personalized learner guidance [[cite:partnerships://019f6d87-c85c-7fda-b76f-be2c08612f33|Partnerships signal]]
